payload.reason: The evidence provides specific graph-based features that are considered in the analysis.

claims.text: The graph-based features include Coreness, Strength, Closeness, and Reciprocity.
Coreness reflects the targeted author's position in the graph before and after interactions.
Strength measures the intensity of connections in the graph.
Closeness indicates the average node centrality in terms of distance within the graph.
Reciprocity measures the general reciprocity of exchanges between users.
